changes: libnetwork: query firewalld's permanent policies before creating docker-forwarding, so firewalld no longer logs NAME_CONFLICT at every start (alarm-aurora's patch, rebased onto 28.5.2).
notes: alarm-aurora builds Docker 29.9.2 from upstream; Debian testing has 28.5.2, where the same function lives in engine/libnetwork/iptables/firewalld.go. The patch adds a unit test (TestSetupDockerForwardingPolicy) that needs no root and no firewalld. Not cross-buildable as Debian packages it: its golang-*-dev build dependencies are Architecture: all without Multi-Arch: foreign.
